plugin.sha2-constants.title: SHA-2 constants from prime roots
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha256-k: SHA-256 round constants K (cube roots of the first 64 primes)
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha512-k: SHA-512 round constants K (cube roots of the first 80 primes)
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha256-iv: SHA-256 initial hash value (square roots of the first 8 primes)
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha512-iv: SHA-512 initial hash value (square roots of the first 8 primes)
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha384-iv: SHA-384 initial hash value (square roots of primes 9 to 16)
plugin.sha2-constants.preset.sha224-iv: SHA-224 initial hash value (second 32 fractional bits, primes 9 to 16)
plugin.sha2-constants.param.constantHint: Which FIPS 180-4 table to derive from the roots of primes.
plugin.sha2-constants.op.word: Word – take fractional bits of the root of one prime
plugin.sha2-constants.op.compare: Compare – check the derived words against FIPS 180-4
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha25: SHA-224 and SHA-256 use 64 round constants of 32 bits: the first 32 bits of the fractional parts of the cube roots of the first 64 primes (FIPS 180-4 {{section}}). Each step derives one word with exact integer arithmetic; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha51: SHA-384, SHA-512 and SHA-512/t use 80 round constants of 64 bits: the first 64 bits of the fractional parts of the cube roots of the first 80 primes (FIPS 180-4 {{section}}). Each step derives one word with exact integer arithmetic; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha25: The SHA-256 initial hash value has 8 words of 32 bits: the first 32 bits of the fractional parts of the square roots of the first 8 primes (FIPS 180-4 {{section}}). Each step derives one word with exact integer arithmetic; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha51: The SHA-512 initial hash value has 8 words of 64 bits: the first 64 bits of the fractional parts of the square roots of the first 8 primes (FIPS 180-4 {{section}}). Each step derives one word with exact integer arithmetic; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha38: The SHA-384 initial hash value has 8 words of 64 bits: the first 64 bits of the fractional parts of the square roots of primes no. 9 to 16, that is 23 to 53 (FIPS 180-4 {{section}}). Each step derives one word with exact integer arithmetic; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.initial.sha22: The SHA-224 initial hash value has 8 words of 32 bits. FIPS 180-4 {{section}} only lists them. They are the second 32 bits of the 64-bit fractional parts of the square roots of primes no. 9 to 16 (23 to 53): the low halves of the SHA-384 initial words. Each step derives one word; the last step compares the result with the FIPS table.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.wordCube: Prime no. {{n}} is p = {{p}}. In hex, its cube root is {{integer}}.{{word}}… Drop the integer part {{integer}} and keep the first {{bits}} fractional bits: {{symbol}}{{index}} = {{word}}.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.wordSquare: Prime no. {{n}} is p = {{p}}. In hex, its square root is {{integer}}.{{word}}… Drop the integer part {{integer}} and keep the first {{bits}} fractional bits: {{symbol}}{{index}} = {{word}}.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.wordSquareSki: Prime no. {{n}} is p = {{p}}. In hex, its square root is {{integer}}.{{skipped}}{{word}}… Skip the first {{bits}} fractional bits ({{skipped}}, the start of the SHA-384 word) and keep the next {{bits}}: {{symbol}}{{index}} = {{word}}.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.compareMatch: All {{count}} derived words equal the table in FIPS 180-4 {{section}}. The constants are reproducible from public numbers: no hidden choice.
plugin.sha2-constants.step.compareMismat: {{mismatches}} of {{count}} derived words differ from the table in FIPS 180-4 {{section}}.
